metadataRaw.title: Do This Daily for Better Upper Back Posture #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy, daily exercise that can help improve (and maintain) upper back posture. 

It will focus on lengthening and strengthening the muscles that support the shoulders, upper back, and shoulder blades. It's especially good for bad rounded back and shoulder posture.

As a bonus, this exercise can be done at home (in bed) and requires no equipment.

Let us know how it works for you!
